provenance: REAL telemetry captured from Prometheus/OpenSearch/Jaeger by the research engine
known_limitations: Trace evidence has no span status: the research Jaeger adapter discarded tags (audit AI-04).
Evidence rows shared between runs were re-attributed to the later run (audit DATA-01), so some runs are missing modalities (e.g. no logs).
Telemetry windows are now()-15min at investigation time (audit AI-03), not aligned to fault onset.
Ground truth labels were assigned from the scenario definitions by the engineering agent, not by an independent human.
rules: Cases are used only for evaluation. No pipeline thresholds, weights or prompts may be tuned against them; tuning uses eval/scenarios only.
